name: Hindsight
ontology_notes: Canonical repo is vectorize-io/hindsight. Memory types in README Core Concepts: world facts, experiences, observations (consolidated beliefs), mental models. llms.txt also names opinion facts. Units have fact_type world|experience|observation and state valid|invalidated. Banks isolate stores. TEMPR recall is semantic + BM25 + graph + temporal fused with RRF then rerank. Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12818.

ontology.evidence: README Memory Types. API memories/list fact_type world|experience|observation. Mental models and knowledge pages. Not companion-specific (no character autobiography or OOC).
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: retain() LLM-extracts facts, entities, time, relations. LLM wrapper wrap_openai auto-retains after calls. document_id upserts a conversation. MCP tools retain, recall, reflect. Directives and bank mission shape extract. Curation edit/invalidate APIs exist.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: recall() TEMPR four-way search, RRF, rerank, token budget. reflect() is an agentic loop over those tools plus disposition. prefer_observations can drop raw facts superseded by observations. Tags filter. Wrapper recalls before each LLM call. Empty recall is possible.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Invalidate moves a unit out of memory_units into an archive so recall skips it. document_id retain replaces the previous version. Observations are refined rather than silently overwritten (README Observations). Contradictions keep temporal markers.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: retain timestamp. Temporal retrieval arm parses last spring into date ranges (developer/rag-vs-hindsight). occurred dates on units. HINDSIGHT_API_ENABLE_TEMPORAL_RETRIEVAL.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Banks are isolated. Docs cookbook per-user-memory is one bank per user. World vs experience splits fact kind, not user vs character vs relationship.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No trauma/kink/spoiler skip on embedding-relevant hits. Tags can filter if the app tags first. Disposition traits change reflect tone, not whether a fact is retrieved.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: disposition_skepticism 1-5 shapes reflect interpretation. Gemini safety settings exist. No provenance/trust tags that block a jailbreak write from later overriding persona. Stored content is otherwise retrieved.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: Invalidate, DELETE memories/documents, clear_memories, delete_bank. Consolidation can drop ephemeral observations. No NLP forget-that. Deletions do not mark knowledge pages stale.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: retain is an LLM extract plus embeds and graph writes. recall runs four searches, optional rerank (300 candidate cap), token trim. reflect is a multi-step LLM tool loop. Wrapper does recall every call plus retain after.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT. Docker, pip hindsight-api, embedded hindsight-all with local pg0. Ollama/lmstudio listed. Cloud is optional. Intimate chat can stay on one machine if the LLM is local.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Built-in MCP per bank at http://localhost:8888/mcp/{bank_id}/. Also pip hindsight-mcp-server. Tools retain, recall, reflect, bank/document/mental-model ops. llms.txt MCP Integration.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Strongest engine in this slice: typed facts, temporal recall, invalidate, local MIT, official MCP. Still agent memory. Banks are not user/character/relationship. Silence is missing. Wrapper path still retrieves text then generates.

published_eval.name: Agent Memory Benchmark (LongMemEval S and others) on benchmarks.hindsight.vectorize.io
published_eval.claimed_score: LongMemEval S 94.6%; LoComo 10 92%; PersonaMem 32K 86.6%; BEAM 100K 75% (page fetched 2026-09-11)
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Conversational long-term fact/retrieval benches (LongMemEval, LoCoMo-style, PersonaMem, BEAM, LifeBench). Not companion silence, poisoning, or identity drift.
